WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
ss_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        fd.d_year,
        fd.d_qoy,
        fd.d_moy
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN filtered_dates AS fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
),
dw1 AS (
    SELECT
        it.i_category,
        it.i_class,
        it.i_brand,
        it.i_product_name,
        ssf.d_year,
        ssf.d_qoy,
        ssf.d_moy,
        st.s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ssf.ss_sales_price * ssf.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM ss_filtered AS ssf
    JOIN item AS it ON ssf.ss_item_sk = it.i_item_sk
    JOIN store AS st ON ssf.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY
        it.i_category,
        it.i_class,
        it.i_brand,
        it.i_product_name,
        ssf.d_year,
        ssf.d_qoy,
        ssf.d_moy,
        st.s_store_id
    WITH ROLLUP
),
dw2 AS (
    SELECT
        dw1.i_category,
        dw1.i_class,
        dw1.i_brand,
        dw1.i_product_name,
        dw1.d_year,
        dw1.d_qoy,
        dw1.d_moy,
        dw1.s_store_id,
        dw1.sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY dw1.i_category
            ORDER BY dw1.sumsales DESC
        ) AS rk
    FROM dw1
)
SELECT
    dw2.i_category,
    dw2.i_class,
    dw2.i_brand,
    dw2.i_product_name,
    dw2.d_year,
    dw2.d_qoy,
    dw2.d_moy,
    dw2.s_store_id,
    dw2.sumsales,
    dw2.rk
FROM dw2
WHERE dw2.rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    dw2.i_category,
    dw2.i_class,
    dw2.i_brand,
    dw2.i_product_name,
    dw2.d_year,
    dw2.d_qoy,
    dw2.d_moy,
    dw2.s_store_id,
    dw2.sumsales,
    dw2.rk
LIMIT 100
